description: Prepare or execute a server-bound plan to rent a GPU instance. Use when the user has decided to launch; call should_i_run_this first if affordability is unsettled. Called without a plan_id it only *prepares* a plan and returns the canonical spec, a cost estimate, and an approval URL — nothing is allocated and nothing is billed. Execution requires that prepared plan_id plus approval; confirm:true expresses your intent but never substitutes for approval. Executing starts hourly CAD billing against the wallet until the instance is cancelled or terminated.

exclusive_gpu.description: Optional paid GPU-only exclusivity for Standard or Premium. Included in Dedicated.

queue_bid_units.description: Optional bid unit quantity from list_tiers. Added to running GPU-hour price. Aging can promote one queue tier behind customers who purchased it.

tier.description: Paid service tier. Dedicated reserves the entire physical host and requires its full GPU count.

name: create_instance
